about: Libre fonts lt-suite can use. 'bundled' files ship in shared/fonts/<id>/ with the upstream OFL.txt; 'fetch' files are downloaded by setup into <data>/fonts/<id>/ and checked against the pinned sha256. package_score counts official packages in Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch and Homebrew (0-4); preinstalled_default_count counts systems that ship the font by default.

low_vision.note: best I/l/1 separation (0.605 against 0.275); Greek letters, arrows and super/subscripts fall back to Noto Sans

defaults.dyslexia_note: Offer letter- and word-spacing controls instead of a dyslexia font; OpenDyslexic shows no benefit (wery2017, azzarello2026) while spacing has support (zorzi2012, marinus2016). Change letter and word spacing together: letter spacing alone slowed reading in one study (galliussi2020).

evidence_tiers.N: negative evidence from controlled studies or meta-analysis

method.il1_min_distance: min over pairs I~l, l~1, I~1 of (1 - IoU) of binarised glyph ink rendered at 96 px with Pillow, glyphs centred horizontally on a shared baseline; variable fonts at wght 400, wdth 100. 0 = identical shapes, higher = less confusable. Heuristic proxy for letter differentiation, not a validated legibility measure.
method.b_vs_mirrored_d: 1 - IoU of b against horizontally mirrored d; below 0.2 means b and d are near mirror images.
method.o_vs_zero: 1 - IoU of O against 0; slashed or dotted zeros in monospace fonts score low because the IoU ignores small inner marks.
method.diagram_glyphs_missing: count missing from 89 code points that diagram labels use: 49 basic Greek letters, 8 arrows (← ↑ → ↓ ↔ ⇄ ⇌ ⇒), 8 maths signs (− ± × ≤ ≥ ≈ ∞ ∆), 22 super/subscripts (⁺ ⁻ ⁰-⁹ ₀-₉), 8 misc (° µ – — • ′ ″ ‰). Missing glyphs fall back to another font at render time.
method.font_files_measured: Google Fonts repo copies for GF families; upstream release files for DejaVu 2.37, Liberation 2.1.5, Luciole (Luciole.zip), OpenDyslexic 0.91.12 zip, Cantarell 0.311, Nerd Fonts 3.5.1; Adwaita fonts 51 and Iosevka Nerd Font 34.8.0 release files (Nerd-patched, so code point count includes icons).

fonts.readability_evidence: Weak. Fluency gains come from creator-run trials of Shaver-Troup's text formation factors (for example 20 third-graders reported on lexend.com); no peer-reviewed or independent replication was found. The wider-spacing mechanism has independent support: extra-large letter spacing improved reading in dyslexic children [zorzi2012], and Dyslexie's 7% speed gain vanished once Arial's spacing matched [marinus2016]. Extra letter spacing without extra word spacing slowed reading [galliussi2020]. Measured I/l/1 distance 0.298; x-height 0.525 em.

fonts.readability_evidence: Negative. No gain in reading rate or accuracy against Arial and Times New Roman, and no child preferred it [wery2017]. No improvement among 12 fonts for 48 dyslexic readers, where sans serif, monospaced and roman styles helped [rello2013]. Luciole read slightly better than OpenDyslexic for low-vision readers [galiano2023]. Meta-analysis of dyslexia fonts: 15 studies, N=688, g=-0.04 (95% CI -0.15 to 0.07) [azzarello2026]. The similar Dyslexie font gave no benefit in 170 and 147 children [kuster2018]. Its measured I/l/1 distance 0.488 and x-height 0.56 em do not yield measured reading gains.

fonts.preinstalled_on: Ubuntu 26.04 desktop: yes, as the generic sans-serif alias and document font (fontconfig 60-latin.conf lists Noto Sans first); the GNOME UI font there is Ubuntu Sans. Fedora 36+: yes, default sans (default-fonts-core-sans requires google-noto-sans-vf-fonts). ChromeOS: not verified. Android (AOSP): Noto Sans for non-Latin scripts only. macOS 26 and Windows 11: no.
fonts.evidence_tier: A: large independent peer-reviewed study in typical adult readers
fonts.readability_evidence: Largest independent study in this list [wallace2022]: 352 adults, 16 size-normalised fonts. Noto Sans had the highest preference (win rate 62%, Elo 1644, both first of 16). Its reading speed was the median (272 WPM) and comprehension mid-table (91%); the study found no population-level font effect on speed, and readers were fastest in their preferred font only at chance. Measured weakness: I and l differ only by height (I~l 0.275, against Atkinson Hyperlegible Next 0.605).
fonts.script_coverage: Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Vietnamese, IPA; the Google Fonts build adds Devanagari (3094 code points measured). Separate Noto Sans <Script> families cover most other Unicode scripts. Lacks ← ↑ → ↓ ⇌ ≤ ≥ ≈ ∞ ∆, which fall back to another font. Ubuntu's fonts-noto-core 20201225 build also lacks U+2212 (minus sign); Fedora, Arch and Homebrew ship the newer 2.015 file, which lt-suite bundles.
